messages:
Anita: Quick check — tomorrow's SRE onsite (10:30 PT). Who's scribing and who is the debrief lead? Also need ASR transcript access for candidate consent.
Sam: I can scribe for the first two loops (10:30 + 11:15). Can someone cover 1:00?
Leo: I can pick up 1:00. pls add me to the doc and calendar invite.
Jia: I set up the shared debrief doc: https://docs.example.com/sre-debrief-2026 — scribe column + score buckets there.
People Ops: Thanks @Anita — added @Sam and @Leo to the invite and doc. Note: debrief window = 15m after last interview, please keep to that.
Anita: Thanks. Quick rubric Q: for system design, do we want "tradeoffs" to be 0-3 or 0-5? current rubric shows 0-3 but hiring manager asked for more granularity.
Sam: I vote 0-5 for tradeoffs (helps differentiation). Keep implementation and communication at 0-3.
Leo: +1 for 0-5 tradeoffs. Also reminder: normalize across panels — please mark if you escalated any "missing context" items.
Jia: Updated rubric in the doc: tradeoffs = 0-5. Changed the rubric link in calendar invite.
oncall-bot: Reminder: run mic test 10 min before the loop — use room zoom: zr-ops-21.
Anita: Room info in invite:
```
Zoom: zoom.company.com/j/988-334-220
Passcode: redwood
AV lead: @Raj (oncall)
```
Sam: ASR: candidate consent checked? we need explicit yes in the doc.
People Ops: Candidate consent already captured in offer flow, but pinged recruiter to confirm explicit ASR consent for this session.
Leo: Small logistics: can we start 5 minutes early if people are ready? gives buffer for A/V issues.
Anita: Good idea. Let's aim to start 5 min early and keep debrief strict 15m.
Sam: One more ask — tagging: if you call out a 'red flag', add a one-line note under "flags" in the doc so TLs can see them during debrief.
Jia: Done — added a flags column and a short template.
People Ops: All set from ops side. I'll ping again 30m before and confirm scribe/lead. :thumbsup:
Anita: Perfect. Thanks all.
